description: The defender's legacy reactive StratagemDialog (enemy_targets_unit_shooting fold-in) now carries the same 'Decline — don't offer again this phase' affordance as window mode. Fixture ork11e_orks_reactive: P1 Custodes ACTIVE, P2 Orks. Setup-only privileges: P2's detachment is flipped to Kult of Speed and its stratagems reloaded; the Warbikers (SPEED FREEKS) are moved within Custodian Guard C's range. Custodian Guard C (selected by clicking its token) targets the Warbikers; the Ork player's dialog offers SPEEDIEST FREEKS, and a real click on 'Decline — don't offer again this phase' closes it without spending CP, resumes the attack and suppresses the defender prompt for the rest of the phase (the same targeting re-checked offers nothing), while the stratagem itself stays usable later (suppression is per prompt, not a use).

steps.comment: setup privilege: the Warbikers move within Custodian Guard C's range, clear of every enemy
the panel auto-highlights a shooter on phase entry; picking another unit first makes the Custodian Guard C token click a real selection
